BALUCHISTAN PROVINCIAL WORKERS' ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL PLOTS
REGULATIONS, 1977
BALUCHISTAN
PROVINCIAL WORKERS' ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL PLOTS REGULATIONS, 1977
[No. 20‑37/77‑Labour.‑‑--
28th September, 1977 ‑‑ Regulations framed by Baluchistan
Provincial Workers Welfare Board in exercise of the powers conferred by Section
11‑C (f) of the Worker's Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971, for carrying into
effect the scheme of residential plots to the workers in the Province of
Baluchistan.]
[Baluchistan
Gaz. Extr. 28th Sep. 1977, p. 1]
1. Short title, extent and
commencement‑--
(i) These regulation may be
called the Baluchistan Provincial Workers Allotment of Residential Plots
Regulation, 1977.
(ii) These shall cone into force
at once.
2. Definitions.‑----- In
these regulations unless the context otherwise requires, the following
expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to then, that
is to say :‑
(a) "Regulations" means the
Baluchistan Workers' Allotment of Residential Plots Regulations, 1977.
(b) "Ordinance" means the Workers Welfare Fund
Ordinance, 1971.
(c) "Worker" means a worker as
defined in section 2 (XXVIII) of Industrial Relations Ordinance. 1969.
(d) "Establishment" means an
establishment as defined in Section 2 (IX) of Industrial Relations Ordinance,
1969.
(e) "Industry" means an industry
as defined in Section 2 (XIV) of Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969.
(f) "Secretary" means an. officer
of the Workers' Welfare Board appointed to act as ex‑officio Secretary
Allotment Committee.
(g) "Allotment Committee" means
the committee constituted under the Baluchistan Provincial Workers' Allotment
of Residential Plots Regulations, 1977.
(h) "Salary" means basic regular
monthly wages including dearness allowance, adhoc relief, cost of living
allowance etc., sanctioned by the Government from time‑to time, but does
not include bonus or other monetary benefits, etc.
(i) "Family" means his wife or
her husband as the case may be and will include children wholly dependent on
him or her.
(j) "Station" means a town or a
city where the residential plots have been developed for the purpose of
allotment to the workers.
(k) "Board". means the Provincial
Workers' Welfare Board constituted under Section 11A of the Workers' Welfare
Fund Ordinance, 1971.
(l) "Form" means a form appended to the Regulations.
3. Constitution of Allotment
Committee.‑--
(a) A Committee consisting of 3 members
shall be constituted for the purpose of allotment of plots as under:
(i) the Director Labour Welfare Baluchistan
will act as Chairman of the said committee ;
(ii) two other non‑official members
representing the employers ‑a and workers of that station to be nominated
by the Board ; and
(iii) as officer of the Workers' Welfare, Board
may be appointed as an ex‑officio Secretary Allotment Committee.
(b) The term of non‑official members shall be two years.
(c) Any member may, resign from the membership of the Allotment
Committee‑ by intimating to the Chairman of the Committee. The Board may
remove any member for gross mis‑conduct/corruption or on similar serious
charges. Any member will cease to remain a member of the Allotment Committee,
if be absents himself from the three consecutive meetings of the Committee.
4. Procedure for Allotment.‑--The
following procedure shall inter alia be followed for allotment :‑‑
(a)The Allotment Committee will
invite applications for allotment of plots from eligible workers of the station
on the prescribed form 'P' and shall advertise the last date for the receipt of
such applications through various information media.
(b) Application forms should be
serially numbered and shall be sold on price of Re. 1/‑ each by the
Secretary, Allotment Committee. The names of the applicant(s) together with the
amount realised shall be entered in a register maintained by the Secretary,
Allotment Committee who will deposit the money so collected in fund to be
constituted for the purpose. Any other application shall not be liable t
